welcome.heading: Welcome to NHBC Osogbo
welcome.leadText: Grace, peace, and love to you in the name of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
welcome.content: Whether you are joining us for the first time, looking for a church home, or seeking to deepen your walk with God, we are thrilled to welcome you. At New Heritage Baptist Church, Osogbo, we are a close-knit spiritual family dedicated to the undiluted Word of God, transformative worship, fervent prayer, and heartfelt fellowship. Come as you are, and discover God's extraordinary purpose for your life.

about.story: New Heritage Baptist Church (NHBC Osogbo) was birthed out of a divine vision to establish a beacon of biblical truth, Holy Spirit power, and genuine Christian discipleship in Osogbo, the capital city of Osun State. From humble beginnings as a fellowship of passionate believers, God has expanded the ministry into a thriving spiritual haven where families find hope, youths find godly identity, and leaders are equipped to influence society with the virtues of the Kingdom.
about.vision: To be a vibrant, Christ-centered, Bible-believing church that glorifies God through authentic worship, discipleship, and holistic transformation of individuals, families, and society in Osogbo and beyond.
about.mission: To lead people into a living, personal relationship with Jesus Christ, nurture them toward spiritual maturity through sound biblical teaching, foster genuine Christian fellowship, and equip believers for impactful ministry in our community and the world.

beliefs.title: The Authority of the Scriptures
beliefs.text: We believe the Holy Bible is the inspired, inerrant, and infallible Word of God, serving as the supreme authority in all matters of faith, doctrine, and conduct (2 Timothy 3:16-17).

beliefs.title: The Triune God
beliefs.text: We believe in one God eternally existent in three co-equal persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19).

beliefs.title: Salvation by Grace through Faith
beliefs.text: Salvation is God's gracious gift to humanity through faith in Jesus Christ's atoning death and bodily resurrection, entirely apart from human works (Ephesians 2:8-9).

beliefs.title: Believer's Baptism by Immersion
beliefs.text: In accordance with New Testament practice, baptism is an outward testimony of inward faith, administered by full immersion in water in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Romans 6:3-4).

beliefs.title: Priesthood of All Believers
beliefs.text: Every regenerated believer has direct access to God through Christ and is uniquely endowed with spiritual gifts for Christian service and intercession (1 Peter 2:9).

beliefs.title: Autonomy and Fellowship of the Local Church
beliefs.text: Under the lordship of Christ, the local church is self-governing while maintaining joyful cooperative fellowship with the wider Baptist family and the Body of Christ.

beliefs.title: The Great Commission & Second Coming
beliefs.text: We are called to proclaim the Gospel to every soul and eagerly await the blessed hope of Jesus Christ's triumphant return (Matthew 28:19-20; Titus 2:13).

values.name: Biblical Truth

values.name: Fervent Prayer

values.name: Sacrificial Love
values.description: Cultivating authentic warmth, deep fellowship, and selfless hospitality for members and visitors alike.

values.name: Holiness & Integrity
values.description: Living lives worthy of Christ, walking with pure conscience and honest transparency before God and people.

values.name: Passionate Worship
values.description: Offering God our highest adoration in spirit and in truth with heartfelt songs and obedient hearts.

values.name: Compassionate Outreach
values.description: Active benevolence, evangelism, and community uplifting throughout Osogbo and rural mission fields.

ministries.name: Heritage Children Ministry
ministries.shortDescription: Nurturing tender hearts in God's love through engaging Bible lessons, fun activities, and godly values.
ministries.fullDescription: The Children's Ministry at NHBC Osogbo provides a secure, joyful, and spiritually stimulating environment for children from infancy through primary school age. Through creative Bible storytelling, memory verses, action songs, and age-appropriate discipleship, we partner with parents to lay an unshakeable foundation for lifelong faith.
ministries.meetingSchedule: Sundays during Worship Service (8:30 AM – 10:30 AM)

ministries.name: Heritage Youths & Young Adults
ministries.shortDescription: Empowering young people to stand courageously for Christ, excel academically, and discover purpose.
ministries.fullDescription: A dynamic community of teens, campus undergraduates, Corpers (NYSC), and young career professionals. We hold vibrant fellowships, campus outreaches, leadership training workshops, and spiritual retreats designed to address modern life challenges with eternal biblical truth.
ministries.meetingSchedule: Saturdays at 4:30 PM & First Sundays at 4:00 PM

ministries.name: Heritage Voices Choir & Music
ministries.shortDescription: Ushering the congregation into God's manifest presence through spirit-filled praise, hymns, and anthems.
ministries.fullDescription: Heritage Voices comprises consecrated vocalists and skilled instrumentalists called to minister through song. The ministry spans traditional Baptist hymnody, classical anthems, and lively contemporary Nigerian praise that stirs repentance, joy, and reverent adoration.
ministries.meetingSchedule: Rehearsals: Thursdays at 5:30 PM & Saturdays at 4:00 PM

ministries.name: Women's Missionary Union (WMU)
ministries.shortDescription: Uniting women in prayer, compassionate benevolence, home-building, and worldwide missionary endeavor.
ministries.fullDescription: The Women's Missionary Union encompasses Sunbeams, Girls' Auxiliary (GA), Lydia Auxiliary, and the Women's Missionary Society (WMS). Our mission is to equip women to model Christ in their families, advance community benevolence, and support missionary outposts in Nigeria.
ministries.meetingSchedule: Tuesdays at 4:30 PM & Monthly General Meetings

ministries.name: Men's Missionary Union (MMU)
ministries.shortDescription: Raising godly fathers, faithful husbands, and proactive men who lead their homes and church with integrity.
ministries.fullDescription: The Men's Missionary Union unites the Royal Ambassadors (RA) and the Men's Fellowship. We challenge men to spiritual leadership, prayerful brotherhood, vocational mentorship, and active physical and spiritual support of the church's vision.
ministries.meetingSchedule: Third Sunday of every month after service

ministries.name: Sunday School Department
ministries.shortDescription: The teaching arm of the church dedicated to systematic, verse-by-verse scriptural illumination.
ministries.fullDescription: Sunday School is where believers of all age groups delve deeply into God's Word in small, interactive classes. With well-trained facilitators and comprehensive study guides, every lesson is geared toward practical Christian living and doctrinal soundness.

ministries.name: Evangelism & Community Missions
ministries.shortDescription: Taking the Gospel to streets, hospitals, schools, and unreached communities across Osun State.
ministries.fullDescription: Fulfilling the Great Commission through tract distribution, open-air crusades, prison visitation, hospital ministry, and rural missionary support. We believe that an inward-focused church ceases to fulfill Christ's heartbeat.

ministries.name: Intercessory Prayer Ministry
ministries.shortDescription: Standing in the gap for the church, our members, the city of Osogbo, and the nation of Nigeria.
ministries.fullDescription: An anointed company of watchmen on the walls of Zion. The prayer team maintains regular vigils, fasts, and continuous intercessory coverage for church leadership, member prayer requests, and national righteousness.
ministries.meetingSchedule: Fridays at 6:00 PM & Monthly Night Vigils (11:00 PM)

sermons.title: Walking in the Exceeding Greatness of His Power
sermons.speaker: [Revd. Dr. Senior Pastor Name]
sermons.description: An illuminating exposition on the immeasurable power made available to every believer in Christ. Discover how to shift from human anxiety to supernatural reliance on the Holy Spirit.

sermons.title: The Unfailing Covenant of Divine Preservation
sermons.speaker: [Revd. Dr. Senior Pastor Name]
sermons.description: A message of comfort and divine assurance during turbulent times. The Lord who keeps Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps—He is your shade upon your right hand.

sermons.title: Stewardship that Unlocks Kingdom Abundance
sermons.speaker: [Guest Baptist Minister Name]
sermons.description: Understanding that God loves a cheerful giver. Biblical principles for managing finances, honoring God with tithes, and sowing seed toward eternal rewards.

sermons.title: Raising an Altared Generation in Perilous Times
sermons.speaker: [Revd. Associate Pastor Name]
sermons.description: A clarion call to parents and youth to kindle the flame of family worship, personal holiness, and spiritual sensitivity amidst cultural pressures.

news.title: Preparations in Full Gear for the Believers' Heritage Convention 2026
news.author: Church Media Office
news.excerpt: The church leadership invites all members, friends, and the general public in Osogbo to our flagship 4-day annual convention.
news.content: We are delighted to announce that all preparations for our 2026 Believers' Heritage Convention are underway. The theme for this year's encounter promises a transformative outpouring of grace, prophetic direction, and divine establishment. We encourage members to invite neighbors, colleagues, and family members. Transportation arrangements from major junctions across Osogbo will be communicated soon.

news.title: Innovative Visual Bible Curriculum Launched in Children's Church
news.author: Children Ministry Directorate
news.excerpt: Our Children's Department has rolled out an enriched biblical teaching curriculum with illustrated workbooks and memory crafts.
news.content: To foster deeper understanding and love for God's Word among our young ones, the Children Ministry has introduced a specialized illustrated curriculum. Every Sunday, children will explore biblical narratives with tactile crafts, audio-visual Bible lessons, and take-home family devotion sheets. Parents are encouraged to review these sheets with their children during the week.

news.title: WMU Concludes Successful Skills Acquisition and Food Donation Outreach
news.author: WMU Secretariat
news.excerpt: Over 120 women and youths benefited from free vocational training in catering, craft-making, and financial budgeting.
news.content: The Women's Missionary Union of NHBC Osogbo successfully rounded off its annual community outreach week. Aside from donating food provisions and toiletries to widows and elderly community members, participants received hands-on coaching in soap making, confectionery, and modern home management. Glory to God for touching lives through our collective giving.
